semantics.type: Every uncaptured selection samples[0,99], including non-yards. <25 plus factoryBuildingType returns global ENGINEER. Otherwise current house side picks E1/E2; neutral country returns CTECH; armed actor samples[0,99], <15 selects CTECH. At most one engineer attempt even after allocation/placement failure.
semantics.placement: Pick one provided source foundation offset uniformly; supply cell(base+offset)*256+(128,164),z0. Actual map lookup548000 and Cell free infantry spot4764b0. Initialized483390 gives quarter-cell subspots. Input center request draws[0,3], source search skips slots0/1 and uses slots2/3/4; capacity3 here. Occupancy bits and flat height are supplied dependencies.
semantics.phase: Actual Selling phase0 broadcasts radio23; phase1 broadcasts radio3 (unlink), creates crew, queues Scatter(empty,true,false) then Move2; phase2 waits for completion and credits. These radio calls do not establish animation timing. Project first selling update maps crew creation; exact source outer timing remains uncalibrated. See ra2-sale-egress-reference.json for the corrected broadcast and building-admission queries.
